name: Lurie HTT Straightening Constraint via cvc5
description: cvc5 SMT proof of Lurie straightening/unstraightening uniqueness constraint

test_positive_straightening_to_coCartesi.description: cvc5 SAT: functor F: C → ∞-Cat straightens to a coCartesian fibration

test_positive_straightening_uniqueness.description: cvc5 SAT: Lurie equivalence ensures unique straightening of F

test_positive_unstraightening_recovery.description: cvc5 SAT: unstraightening recovers F from coCartesian fibration

test_negative_non_unique_straightening.description: cvc5 UNSAT: non-unique straightenings violate Lurie equivalence

test_negative_non_cocartesian_fibration.description: cvc5 UNSAT: non-coCartesian fibration violates Lurie straightening

test_negative_unstraightening_failure.description: cvc5 UNSAT: failure to recover F from fibration violates Lurie equivalence

test_boundary_constant_functor.description: cvc5 SAT: constant functor straightens to product fibration

test_boundary_identity_functor.description: cvc5 SAT: identity functor Id: C → C straightens to projection

test_boundary_symbolic_lurie_equivalence.description: sympy: symbolic encoding of Lurie's straightening equivalence
test_boundary_symbolic_lurie_equivalence.theorem: ∃! p: E → C (coCartesian) such that p ≅ St(F)
test_boundary_symbolic_lurie_equivalence.equivalence: Unst ∘ St ≅ Id and St ∘ Unst ≅ Id
